newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 15.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The State Commission for Economic Restructuring vows to vigorously promote state sector reform this year, including the transformation of more state enterprises into shareholding companies.
- China has set up around 9,200 joint stock companies with a combined share capital of 600 billion yuan since 1984 when the central government first authorised the establishment of the firms.
- China's foreign trade surplus hit $6.71 billion in the first three months of this year, an increase of 25.7 percent against the same period last year.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China will possibly lower bank reserve ratios by three percentage points to 10 percent from the current 13 percent in the second quarter of this year.
- Experts expect prices for home computers to drop by 25 percent this year.
